title: Grave of the Forgotten
description:
There is a single grave with a [jitter][aqua]roiling blue flame[/aqua][/jitter]...

A prideful warrior died in battle but its soul is restless. It wants to keep fighting, you feel it [sine]begging[/sine] to journey with you.

But perhaps it's better for it to face the [red]truth[/red]?

options.title: Confront with Truth
options.description: Add [red]Decay[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card that [gold]Exhausts[/gold] with [purple]Soul's Power[/purple].
options.requires: You have no cards with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] that can be [purple]Enchanted[/purple].

conditions: At least one card with Exhaust that can be enchanted
notes: The soul of a prideful warrior seeks to journey with you. The [gold]Accept[/gold] option provides [gold]Forgotten Soul[/gold] relic with no additional cost. The [gold]Confront with Truth[/gold] option is locked unless you have at least one card with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] that can be [purple]Enchanted[/purple]. Choosing to confront adds [red]Decay[/red] curse to your deck and enchants one exhausting card with [purple]Soul's Power[/purple]. The event features unique narrative text that changes based on which option you choose.
